name: Hana Miko
source:
The protagonist, an apprentice onmyoji (Japanese exorcist), begins a live-in apprenticeship in Kagurahama Town to become a full-fledged onmyoji. With a completely new home and high school, they dive into this unfamiliar world filled with both excitement and anxiety.

One day, the protagonist accidentally involves a female classmate, Hana Homusubi, in a youkai extermination and ends up causing her serious injury.

In a desperate attempt to save her, the protagonist transfers some onmyoji power to Hana, which heals her — but unexpectedly, the power transforms her into a Magical Shrine Maiden.

[From [url=https://manateecruise.booth.pm/items/7159058]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名见习阴阳师（日本驱魔师），为了成为一名正式的阴阳师，在神乐滨町开始了寄宿学徒生涯。有了全新的家和高中，他们进入了这个充满兴奋和焦虑的陌生世界。

某日，主人公在一次妖怪消灭行动中意外卷入了女同学凤结花，并导致她受了重伤。

为了拯救她，主人公将一些阴阳师的力量转移给了花，这治愈了她——但出乎意料的是，这种力量将她变成了魔法巫女。

[来自[url=https://manateecruise.booth.pm/items/7159058]BOOTH[/url]]
